title: Two Toddler Sisters, Grass Picnic Lawn - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century black-and-white snapshot featuring two young toddler girls enjoying a bright, sunny afternoon outdoors. Seated together on the lawn beside a plaid picnic blanket and a metal thermos, the girl on the left wears a light-colored knit sweater with a Peter Pan collar, a dark skirt, and a small bow in her curly hair. The younger girl on the right sits in a frilly light dress and short socks. The print has characteristic deckled edges typical of amateur family snapshots from the late 1940s and early 1950s.
